mechanics.title: Favorites
mechanics.description: Click the star next to a world icon to bookmark it. Bookmarked worlds are pinned to the top (ordered by last played) and cannot be deleted until unmarked. Works for single-player and multiplayer lists.

getting_started: Click the star beside a world on the select screen.
name: Cherished Worlds
summary: Adds a star icon next to every world and server on the select screens. Starred worlds sort to the top and cannot be deleted until unstarred.
